name: navigate_to_section
description: Navigate to a specific section of the menu or application. Use this whenever the user asks to see a category, go to the cart, or view reviews.

section.description: The target section ID. 'cart' opens the shopping cart. 'cuenta' opens the final bill.

name: add_to_cart
description: Add a specific item to the order/cart. Detect the item name and quantity from user speech.

item_name.description: The name of the dish or product to add.

quantity.description: The quantity to add. Default to 1 if not specified.
